result:
Implementation complete and verified. 

## Bounded leased-delivery ordering — implemented (per delivery-order-decision.md)

**Scope honored:** edited only `internal/daemon/ingest.go` (dispatch ordering), `drain.go` (bounded look-ahead), added `delivery_order.go` + `delivery_order_test.go`, and inverted `prompt_order_v6_test.go`. No edits to delivery_lease/seal, daemon.go/handlers.go, store, observer, CLI, unrelated tests, docs, or the carry ledger. delivery_archive/rollover prototypes untouched.

**Mechanism:**
- `delivery_order.go`: `predecessorsAcknowledged(session, arrival)` — bounded scan of the journal's lease/ack maps (mirrors `acknowledged`'s locking; proceeds rather than wedges when the frontier is unreadable); the `orderingApplies` discriminator; wrappers; `deferredLine`; counters.
- `ingest.go` dispatch: a blocked turn-derived leased delivery returns retryable — publishes nothing, leaves WAL/blob intact, releases seen ownership, never waits on a worker.
- `drain.go` `drainFile`: the durable offset now advances only over the contiguous consumed prefix while the read position runs ahead; a blocked line is **deferred** and a **bounded look-ahead** processes the later line that holds the missing predecessor (the reversed-WAL-vs-lease case), rolling the front forward via `processed`/`reattempt`. Never advances past an unresolved line; cross-file predecessors retry on later passes; no busy-spin, no lease reassignment.

**Terminal-safety:** confirmed denial/failure **precede** `leaseDelivery` on both paths, so a denied delivery never consumes an arrival and can't be an immortal predecessor — no new completion semantic needed (documented as the safety basis).

**Concrete contract issue I surfaced (and resolved, flagged for you):** applying the block to **host-identified reads** regressed `TestCarriedDefect_SP08D2` (its fixture cuts an earlier same-session read's ACK and expects the later read to publish/supersede) for **zero** ordering benefit — reads aren't turn-derived. I narrowed the **block** to turn-derived events (`Event.ToolUseID == ""`) while the predecessor **query** still counts all arrivals. This deviates from the decision's literal "any leased event"; the exact rationale and a one-line revert path (revert `orderingApplies` + re-fixture SP08-D2) are in `delivery-order-work.md` §"Coordinator note."

**Test outcomes (real Go exit status, no pipe masking; logs in `dist/v6-remediation/`):**
- `TestDeliveryOrder_PredecessorsAcknowledgedGate` — PASS
- `TestDeliveryOrder_DrainReversedWALvsLeaseOrder` (reversed WAL-vs-lease after restart, actual drain, look-ahead deferred+resolved, `n==2`, turn 0 = earliest) — PASS
- `TestPromptOrder_V6_OrderingGateGivesTurnZeroToEarliestLeasedArrival` (inverted defect → desired behavior at the actual dispatch layer) — PASS
- `TestPromptOrder_V6_UnleasedEarlierSpooledIsSeparateUncertainty` — PASS
- Focused regression `TestDrain|TestDelivery|TestIngest|TestCarriedDefect_SP08D` — **exit 0** (SP08-D2 preserved after the narrowing)

Build/vet/gofmt clean. No universal host-order claim (ordering is among leased arrivals; the unleased-earlier case remains an explicit uncertainty). Handoff in `plans/sdd/V6-remediation/delivery-order-work.md`; main integrates full-package checks.
